concepts: DIET trial NCT04645680 microbiome mediation analysis high fiber diet immunotherapy melanoma

Has the DIET trial (NCT04645680) published microbiome sequencing data showing specific bacterial taxa or metabolic pathway changes that mediate the clinical efficacy of high-fiber diet intervention in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade?
gap.question: Does the DIET trial (NCT04645680) or other human dietary intervention trials report specific gut microbiome compositional or functional changes that statistically mediate the observed clinical efficacy improvements in ICI-treated patients?
success_criteria: Identification of a published report from the DIET trial or similar human dietary intervention study that includes: (1) specific microbiome taxa or functional pathway changes associated with the dietary intervention, (2) statistical mediation analysis linking microbiome changes to ICI clinical outcomes (ORR, PFS, OS), or (3) explicit statement that microbiome mediation data is pending/unavailable.
gap.user_scope: How does the gut microbiome modulate the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumours, and what mechanisms mediate that effect?
